narrative.overview: The store is bold, minimal, confident and athletic, with the visual discipline of the user's Nike and Represent references. Real clothing and real people carry the identity. Condensed headlines give the brand presence; restrained controls keep shopping easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Bold condensed headings with quiet shopping controls.
Authentic campaign, product and customer photography.
White shopping surfaces and full-width black brand sections.
Sharp corners, restrained rules and consistent spacing.
Mobile layouts that keep products and required options clear.

rules.name: The Content Rule
rules.body: Product imagery, real colour swatches and customer media supply colour; the store interface stays restrained.

rules.name: The Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Hero type belongs in a hero. Product controls, panels and admin screens use a smaller, functional scale.

dos: Do reuse the BFL identity, real catalogue and authentic photography.
Do keep the garment clear of headline and control overlays.
Do use stable image proportions and responsive grid tracks.
Do expose the order total before the final payment action.
Do preserve keyboard focus, selected states and reduced-motion behaviour.
donts: Don't invent reviews, stock levels, discounts or delivery claims.
Don't add decorative gradients, excessive shadows or oversized rounded containers.
Don't load old campaign slides or videos before they are needed.
Don't expose backend implementation details in customer status messages.
Don't add new styles to the retired legacy stylesheet.
